check_distributed_training: check if the current process is part of a distributed training run with world size greater than one
all_reduce_tensor: perform an all reduce operation on a tensor across all processes using sum, min, max, or mean reduction
gather_tensors_from_all: gather tensors from all processes in a distributed training job and return them as a list
broadcast_tensor: broadcast a tensor from a source rank to all processes in both distributed and non-distributed scenarios
broadcast_object: broadcast a serializable Python object from a source rank to all workers using torch distributed broadcast
